name: Mateo Rossi
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began in his father's auto repair shop in Buenos Aires. Tinkering with engines from a young age, he developed a keen understanding of mechanics and a passion for speed. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on material science and composite structures. His career began with a local racing team, where he honed his skills in composite repair and fabrication, quickly becoming known for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to find innovative solutions under pressure. He now brings his expertise to Erebus Motorsport, driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance through advanced composite technology.

Mateo approaches his work with a blend of technical precision and creative problem-solving. He's constantly seeking new ways to improve the strength and lightness of components, often experimenting with unconventional materials and techniques. While he enjoys collaborating with the team, he also values his independence, preferring to immerse himself in his work and let his results speak for themselves. He believes that the key to success in motorsport is not just about speed, but also about the relentless pursuit of innovation.

What sets Mateo apart is his visionary approach to composite technology. He's not content with simply repairing or replicating existing designs; he's always looking for ways to improve them. He possesses a remarkable ability to visualize complex structures in his mind and translate them into reality. This, combined with his innate understanding of materials, makes him a valuable asset to any team striving for excellence.

physical.description: Mateo is of average height, with a lean build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Refuses to listen to music while working, preferring the quiet hum of the workshop.
